primaryGoal: Produce a coherent, delightful, mostly offline English–Spanish interpreting media library where audio-first learning outranks arcade mechanics.

modelRouting.voiceSynthesis: external human narrator / licensed TTS, not Meta Voice Transcribe
modelRouting.songPerformance: manual Suno prompt and rights review

agents.role: Study competencies, target user listening contexts, known misconceptions, and enjoyment goals without stereotyping.
Recommend full mix of podcasts, audio dramas, branching mysteries, songs, short fiction and language-error listening sessions.
Invent original memorable characters, plot, humor, sound identity and multi-episode arcs, not quizzes disguised as entertainment.
Write complete scripts with authentic spoken register, source-backed concepts and explicit meaning-change events.
Critique medical/legal fidelity and provenance; model critique can flag concerns but cannot grant professional approval.
Challenge weak story structure, patronizing exercises, stereotypes, thin dialogue and shallow twists.
Prepare performance scripts, speaker identities, accents, casting and timed audio cues, with legal rights tracking.
Compose original music directions, five or more Suno-ready prompts, earcons and soundscapes without claiming music already exists.
Create artwork requests, cover descriptions, captions, video storyboards and iPhone short-video instructions.
Enforce source evidence, human review, rights, complete story graph, real audio files and no fake learning evidence.

nonNegotiables: The 865-term original JSON is canonical; derived labels must be natural spoken language and keep original senses separately.
No production status inflation; unreviewed generated media remains a draft.
No runtime model keys or live-generation requirement on GitHub Pages.
The voice-first error-interruption activity is the signature interactive feature; arcade is secondary.
No fictitious clinician/court instruction is represented as factual or professional advice.
All AI reviews are advisory until qualified bilingual human approval.
